plugins.name: anderson
plugins.description: Gated build loop (plan -> grill -> plan-review -> implement -> diff-review) with per-stage model/effort, an interactive plan-grilling step, two approval gates, real hook-JSON autonomous chaining, and a ship step that commits cleanly on a branch and opens the PR. Big tasks are sized by tokens and built in slices stacked on one branch and one PR, with contracts between slices.
